# Information architecture — Airtable clone

**Edit `ia.json` only.** `IA.md` and `matrix.csv` are generated by `build.mjs` and are overwritten on every run.

```bash
cd ia
node validate.mjs && node build.mjs
```

`ia.json` was derived from the code, not from a plan. It used:

- the Season page configs (`src/season/pages/*.js`)
- the page components for the homepage, the BK pages, `/pricing` and `/templates`
- a crawl of every local `href` rendered on the 25 built routes, which produced the stub list

Every section has an `implementedBy` field pointing at the component that renders it. When pages or links change, update `ia.json` and re-run both scripts.

## What the data shows

- **Most linked routes are stubs.** 59 of the 84 linked local routes (70%) render the shared stub page. These include team solution pages, integration details, template details, legal pages, developer docs, and `/signup` and `/login`.
  - The 25 built routes are spread across 22 templates.
  - `commerce.cta-box` reaches 60 routes, but only because the stub page reuses the homepage CTA.
- **There are 25 shared sections and 39 page-local ones.**
  - Shared on every route: the promo bar, header and footer.
  - Most reused below the shell: `hero.season` (14 routes), `commerce.cta-banner` (12), and `features.card-grid`, `features.side-by-side` and `content.faq` (10 each).
  - All 39 page-local sections are single-use. They belong to the homepage, the BK listing pages, `/pricing`, `/templates` and the enterprise and platform landings.
- **Season templates are compositions, not separate builds.** The 16 Season routes split into 14 templates because each page includes a different mix of sections.
  - They are all rendered by one component (`src/season/SeasonPage.jsx`) from about 27 section types.
  - So a new Season page means writing a new data file, not new components.
  - Only these pages share an identical composition:
    - `/solutions/marketing` and `/solutions/product`
    - `/platform/automations` and `/platform/reporting`
- **Header and footer styling splits into three groups.**
  - `default` (Haas): 67 routes.
  - `season` (ATSeasonSans plus the Season brand mark, set through `[data-font='season']`): 16 routes.
  - `pricing-footer` (the system-font footer variant): `/pricing` only.

## Known reconciliation note

`validate.mjs` flags `features.side-by-side` because its scope text mentions 7 while the computed count is 10. **Both numbers are correct; don't edit either one to match the other.**

- 10 is the total number of routes that use side-by-side rows.
- 7 is how many of those are feature-stack platform pages. The other 3 are `/platform/ai`, `/platform/app-building` and `/about`.

## Content note

The homepage reproduces Airtable's real content from a locally saved copy, for reference only. Every sub-page uses original placeholder copy. Its media slots render original generated SVG illustrations from `src/media/MockMedia.jsx`. These are invented app screens, abstract backgrounds and story scenes, with no real logos, screenshots or people. MockMedia draws inside existing sections and adds no sections of its own, so it doesn't appear in `ia.json`. This IA describes structure only. Keep the clone local; it contains Airtable branding and commercial fonts.
